title: Census Data Explorer
text:
This map shows total population across census tracts in Sarasota County, Florida, using 2023 American Community Survey (5-year) data.

library(tidyverse)
library(tigris)
library(sf)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# Read the Sarasota County census tract population data
sarasota_pop <- read_csv("data/sarasota_tracts_acs2023.csv")

# Load the 2023 census tract boundaries and join population counts
sarasota_map <- tracts(state = "FL", county = "Sarasota", year = 2023, cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  left_join(sarasota_pop, by = c("GEOIDFQ" = "GEO_ID"))

# Plot a choropleth map shaded by total population
ggplot(sarasota_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = total), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Where People Live in Sarasota County, FL",
    subtitle = "Total population by census tract (2023 ACS 5-Year Estimates)",
    fill = "Population",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey"
  ) +
  theme_void()
